claim_scope: Separate held-out tests of indirect flight-motor firing rate, calcium dynamics, wingbeat frequency, and the narrow published splay-state challenge. Passing does not establish direct muscle force, thoracic stretch activation, bilateral steering, or free flight.

admission.lineage_rule: Every raw recording and all workbooks, events, NPY arrays, figures, AVI/TIFF files, and other derivatives must collapse to one source-recording identity before partitioning or counting.
admission.split_rule: Assign every recording from one individual to exactly one immutable calibration, validation, or held-out partition before fitting.
admission.calcium_requirement: Promotion requires the complete reconciled per-animal raw movie, ROI, trace, fit, exclusion, and processing-code lineage. Representative or aggregate traces cannot substitute.
admission.cross_sex_rule: Evidence from males is explicitly labelled and evaluated as transfer evidence for the canonical female simulator.

metrics.integrity: All registered exact-zero digest, group-overlap, duplicate-representation, fit-reference, model-selection, sex-declaration, and non-finite counts must equal zero.
metrics.indirect_mn_firing_rate_error_ratio_ucb9: Held-out error divided by the registered source measurement uncertainty, with a one-sided 95% individual-cluster upper bound no greater than 1.0.
metrics.calcium_trace_error_ratio_ucb95: Held-out calcium-trace error divided by registered measurement uncertainty, with a one-sided 95% individual-cluster upper bound no greater than 1.0.
metrics.wingbeat_frequency_error_ratio_ucb95: Held-out wingbeat-frequency error divided by registered measurement uncertainty, with a one-sided 95% individual-cluster upper bound no greater than 1.0.
metrics.splay_state_effect_error_ratio_ucb95: Held-out error for the registered splay-state contrast divided by source uncertainty, with a one-sided 95% individual-cluster upper bound no greater than 1.0.

known_blockers: Complete per-animal calcium/ROI provenance is not present in the reviewed public archive inventory.
Reported calcium cohort counts are not reconciled.
Direct force, stretch, thoracic compliance, and power-transfer calibration data are incomplete.
